ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a two-bit counter, composed of the JK flip-flop on the left and the T flip-flop on the right, with both sharing the same CLK clock. The Q output of the left JK flip-flop is labeled Q_A; the Q output of the right T flip-flop is labeled Q_B. In the figure, the output of Q_A is connected to the T input of the right T flip-flop; the output of the right flip-flop is fed back to the J and K inputs of the left JK flip-flop. Reasoning: According to the feedback relationship in the figure, the next state of the left JK flip-flop can be written as Q_A^+=\overline{Q_B}; because the right T flip-flop has T=Q_A, Q_B^+=Q_B\oplus Q_A. Initially at t_n, Q_AQ_B=10. Iterating clock by clock: 10 -> 11; 11 -> 00; 00 -> 10. Therefore after three clocks, the state at t_{n+3} is still 10.
